title: Support SLA deadlines
transcript:
Consultant: How does support know when a case is late?
Client: They keep a spreadsheet of promised dates. It is a nightmare and it
is always out of date by Wednesday.
Consultant: What would you want in the CRM instead?
Client: We need an SLA due date on the case so the queue can sort by it.
Consultant: A date and time, or just a date?
Client: Date and time. An SLA that says Tuesday is not much use without an hour.

expected.note: Date/time field on Case; client specifies the precision.
